stages.title: Understand meaning and form
stages.instructions: Read the concept, pattern, examples, contrast, common issue, and recap.

blocks.text: The communicative aim of this lesson is to use for and since with continuing situations to explain and handle ideas related to for & since with appropriate B1 complexity. The central language focus is for and since with continuing situations. In the context of experiences & storytelling, form and meaning work together: first identify the relationship between the ideas, then choose wording that makes that relationship clear to another person. At B1, connected communication matters more than isolated accuracy. Give the main information, link events or reasons, and respond to a follow-up without relying on memorized one-line answers.

blocks.title: Pattern
blocks.text: for and since with continuing situations

blocks.english: A clear explanation addresses recently directly.
blocks.explanation: This model establishes the main communicative move.

blocks.english: The speaker emphasized for several years.
blocks.explanation: This model develops or qualifies the message.

blocks.text: Start with the model “A clear explanation addresses recently directly.” It establishes a useful direction for the exchange. The second model, “The speaker emphasized for several years.” adds another layer: a reason, implication, contrast, or response. Notice how each complete chunk does a communicative job. Practice replacing one detail while preserving the original grammar, stance, and register. Then connect the revised sentence to a relevant consequence or example instead of changing topic abruptly.

A useful pattern for this lesson is: for and since with continuing situations. Use it when the situation genuinely calls for that meaning. Contrast matters: a direct factual statement presents information, while a qualified or hypothetical form changes the speaker's commitment to it. The choice should be driven by evidence, time reference, relationship, and purpose. In listening, pay attention not only to individual words but also to linkers, stress, and the speaker's degree of certainty.

blocks.title: Contrast
blocks.text: Compare a direct statement with language shaped by for and since with continuing situations; the intended meaning determines the form.

A common issue is to select an advanced-looking form without maintaining its meaning across the sentence. That can create a mismatch in time, stance, or register. Check three things: what happened or is being proposed, how certain the speaker is, and what response is expected. For for & since, clarity comes from a coherent message rather than maximum complexity. The later stages recycle the same vocabulary and expressions so that recognition becomes controlled production and then flexible interaction.

blocks.title: Common issue
blocks.text: Do not add complexity that changes the time reference, degree of certainty, or relationship with the listener.

stages.title: Listen for meaning and stance
stages.instructions: Listen first, then reveal the text and notice connections, register, and emphasis.

segments.text: To begin with, A clear explanation addresses recently directly. The speaker emphasized for several years.
In this situation, The speaker emphasized for several years. Our response should account for since I was a child.
From another perspective, Our response should account for since I was a child. This example illustrates at first clearly.
More specifically, This example illustrates at first clearly. We should consider after a while carefully.
Even so, We should consider after a while carefully. The discussion highlighted all of a sudden.
